rules: Em dashes banned. Use pipes | / colons : / commas , / full stops .
One sentence per beat. No exceptions.
Lead with the data, the truth, or the relatable situation. Never with 'we'.
Never talk down to anyone. Never use 'unlock your potential' / 'take your game to the next level'.
TrackMan capitalised exactly. Sentence case otherwise.
Every headline pairs with exactly one CTA per ctas.md.
